originals.why: Gei di ofyn iddi hi means 'you may ask her'. It is natural North Welsh and uses the LEGO in its taught sense, asking her.

originals.ko: 그건 문제가 아니야, 너는 네가 떠나기 전에 그녀에게 물어봐도 돼
originals.why: This is natural, idiomatic Welsh, and ofyn iddi hi keeps the same sense of asking her.
